messages:
Lauren Park: Heads-up: EdgeScale marketplace listing goes live June 2. Need final SI co-sell handoff rules and account mapping before launch. Key items: who owns trial leads, CRM field names, joint announcement assets.

Samir Khan: Suggestion: EdgeScale claims inbound marketplace leads for 7 calendar days. If no outreach, auto-return to Redwood SDR pool. Exceptions: flagged high-intent or enterprise accounts.

Rae Cooper: Agree on 7d. We should define "high-intent" thresholds now: usage_pct >= 40 OR price_plan == 'enterprise' OR 3+ seats signed up.

Dani Wu: For SFDC mapping use these fields: lead_source=marketplace_edgescale, si_partner=EdgeScale (partner_id), si_claimed_at, si_response_deadline, high_intent_flag. Also add handshake_note.

Samir Khan: We'll accept that. EdgeScale wants a webhook to push usage metrics (usage_pct + account_tier). We can forward a sample payload.

Marketplace Bot: Draft playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/partners/edgescale-playbook (editable). Jira for routing: RED-5610 (assignee: Samir Khan) - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RED-5610

Lauren Park: Process check: 1) marketplace intake creates lead in SFDC w/ lead_source. 2) SI sees claimable leads in partner dashboard. 3) SI clicks "Claim" -> sets si_claimed_at & si_partner_assignee. 4) SI must set si_response_deadline = claimed_at + 48h. If not responded by that deadline -> create escalation task + email to joint inbox.

Rae Cooper: Also add: if high_intent_flag == true then do not auto-escalate and notify Redwood AE + Partner CSM.

Dani Wu: We'll add an automation rule: on create -> set auto_escalate_at = created_at + 7d unless high_intent_flag true.

Samir Khan: EdgeScale asks for a co-branded 1-pager and a lead handoff CSV schema for bulk exports. @Dani can you provide schema?

Dani Wu: Yes. CSV fields: account_id, company_name, contact_email, lead_source, partner_id, claimed_at, status, trial_usage_pct, notes. Posting schema to playbook now.

Marketplace Bot: Note: Compliance needs opt-in copy on marketplace listing. Legal review requested: CON-778 (Priya)

Lauren Park: Assignments: Samir owns partner webhook + partner-side ops. Dani owns SFDC flow + CSV schema. Rae owns high-intent rules and monitoring dashboard. I'll coordinate announcement assets with marketing.

Samir Khan: Will post webhook sample by EOD today.

Dani Wu: I'll create SFDC task and link the flow spec in Confluence by Thu.

Rae Cooper: I'll draft dashboard queries for intent and handoff latency.

Marketplace Bot: Reminder: Playbook review call scheduled May 28 - invite sent.

Lauren Park: Thanks team. Once the Confluence playbook has the SFDC field list and the webhook example we can send to EdgeScale for final sign-off. :rocket:
